reviews.text:
We continue being impressed by the highest level of care received by our animals at AMC, both rescues and own pets. We have been recommending AMC to adopters and friends. AMC is our first and often the only choice for specialist and emergency care for our pets.
Professionalism extends to the supporting staff  - receptionists and kind persons helping us on the phone.
5 star treatment, knowledge and follow up. Amazing
Great. Waited less than five minutes and there were drinks and snacks available. Love Dr. Wallach and the front desk staff was very nice as was the technician.
AMC is so attentive. There is a team to care for my baby, they are gentle, familiar with his case and pretty prompt. Very happy.

I am incredibly grateful for the thorough and thoughtful care my dog received after being diagnosed with lymphoma. She was suffering so much and declining quickly but the speedy, coordinated care she received at AMC has made an immense improvement in her quality of life right now and prognosis for the future. Dr Nicole Liebman was wonderful - as were her vet tech and assistant. I especially appreciated the approach to pain relief as my dog was suffering horribly for a week while we awaited cytology results confirming her diagnosis. I felt like the doctor and medical assistants were all excellent, clear communicators who showed compassion for my feelings and were great at explaining the medical situation clearly while also listening to and responding to my questions and concerns.  I know we are in the best of hands at AMC.

The care my cat received was better than the care I receive. Thank you so much for saving my cat's life.  All aspects went well. I was literally in tears I appreciate how comforting my initial contact was.
The care has been excellent and I feel like our pet could only get this level of care at AMC.

Very attentive stuff. Coordinator, vet assistant, doctor.
The whole interaction was very nice for a hospital  Scheduling was extremely easy.
Excellent service and care for my pet

My pet had an er visit 10 days ago. I called ahead and they said there was an exotic er team in and available today. We go, they were not available. Long wait, "seen" by non-exotic vet, sent home. They said we will get a call in 24-72 hours to schedule an appointment for my pet (who had not received any care/treatment or examination, just eyeball looked through the travel enclosure.) No call, waited a few days on this call for no reason. We ended up going with a different vet for her, she needed medicine this whole time.

I called two days later to make an appointment, they said they'd call back. They didn't.

TEN days later, today, they call to schedule an appointment. Ten days is crazy. At least tell me upfront you're not going to give my pet care, this was a time-sensitive emergency and I lost multiple days of antibiotics due to this, and hopefully she ends up okay.

I'm not even the only one in my circle to have issues with this place, but I can only speak to my own.

And less importantly, they kept spelling my pet's name wrong and mislabeling the type of rodent she is. Which isn't terrible in itself, but it definitely adds to my feeling put-off and neglected over here.
